description: This file defines the Java interface 'Acknowledgement' which represents acknowledgment messages (ACK/NACK) for a system, including methods for creating acknowledgements, retrieving details such as label, status code, and entity information, as well as JSON serialization support.

classes.name: Acknowledgement
classes.description: Interface representing an acknowledgment (ACK/NACK) message, including methods for creation, property access, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of the acknowledgement for a specific entity type.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgement instance with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label (ACK/NACK or custom) associated with the acknowledgement.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Indicates whether the acknowledgement represents a successful operation.

methods.name: isTimeout
methods.description: Indicates whether the acknowledgement represents a timeout condition.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Gets the HTTP status code associated with the acknowledgement.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets or updates the optional payload of the acknowledgement.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID that the acknowledgement pertains to.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Provides the response type (RESPONSE or NACK) based on success status.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the acknowledgement to a JSON object including non-hidden fields.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a string identifying the acknowledgement type, based on the entity type.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new acknowledgement with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Gets the label indicating ACK, NACK, or custom label.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgement indicates success.

methods.name: isTimeout
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgement signals a timeout.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the acknowledgement.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets or modifies the acknowledgement's payload.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID associated with the acknowledgement.
